summary: This CSS snippet sets the background color of any element with the class 'reveal' to a yellowish-green color. It's the kind of basic styling you'd use to make certain parts of a presentation or webpage stand out visually.

explanations.1: This is a SCSS comment that marks the 'defaults' section — it tells the SCSS processor that color and style defaults are being defined here, often used in presentation frameworks like Quarto or Reveal.js.
explanations.2: .reveal is a CSS class selector that targets any HTML element with class='reveal' so you can apply styles to it.
explanations.3: rgb(224, 226, 98) is a way to specify a color using Red, Green, and Blue values (each from 0-255); these values create a pale yellow-green shade.
